title: Déjà vu all over again?
summary:
Will the 2014/15 winter tanker market be a repeat of the
previous one? As the regular US baseball season is winding down, the fans are looking forward to the playoffs. Similarly, the people involved in the tanker market are back in full swing after the summer and start to focus on the winter season.
